Use case: identity-preserve. Production animation pose pair.
Exactly TWO separate full-body animation drawings side by side in one portrait image, aspect 1205:1305. Two equal vertical cells. Figure centers at 25% and 75% of total width. Neutral standing boots at y=1200, top of hair around y=180. Preserve this scale for EVERY pose; crouching is shorter, jumping is displaced upward, never zoom a pose to fill its cell. Flat pure chroma green RGB(0,255,0), no floor, cast shadow, gradient, green reflection, checkerboard, writing, symbols, UI, bubbles, watermarks or extra figures. Opaque character with crisp fine cel-shaded outlines, polished eyes, accurate hands, coherent hair locks and fabric folds. Left and right images are two successive ANIMATION DRAWINGS of the SAME identity and outfit, not different costume designs.
ORIGINAL Assistant-004 COMPACT semi-chibi exactly 3.5 heads tall as reference. Head is 29 percent of standing height; chin-to-soles only 2.5 head-heights. Keep SHORT thighs and calves and large head; NEVER lengthen legs into a fashion anime figure. Chestnut long layered hair, asymmetric curved fringe, small plain teal barrette on her left, narrow blue-violet eyes, restrained skeptical scientist expression, not a baby. Preserve reference face, hair, boot style and compact body proportions precisely.
OUTFIT IN BOTH CELLS: Short charcoal jacket with gray cuffs, pale-gray collared shirt, short burgundy tie, black shorts, opaque dark tights and black ankle boots with small teal trim.
LEFT CELL: Idle frontal body, face looks diagonally DOWN-LEFT, chin lowered and head turned left, 225 degrees.
RIGHT CELL: Idle frontal body, face looks mostly LEFT and slightly DOWN, 247.5 degrees.
Only these two poses. Do not reuse identical neutral standing art for active poses. Precise same head size, leg length, eye shape and hair silhouette. Never add failure X marks, wave lines or a visible keyboard.
